correctness.rationale: TARGET route: draft claims explicit rank-2 U(m) basis plus product/convolution and Crofton. Dimension formula correctly specializes BDS Thm 1.1 and binomial det=1 script passes, but script checks only combinatorics, not geometry. Essential gaps: level measures Psi_{k,j} with Kl=sigma_j for j=0..l-1 are asserted without construction (Sec.4 reference empty; l values cannot come from N_k~l/2 scalar Klains alone); evaluation matrix on balls B_E with pairings against Q,H0,S0 is claimed block-triangular det+-1 but no moment integral is computed, and separation of H_j vs H^q in the same {1;1} isotypic component is not shown; S_j vs T_j independence in {0;2}+{2;0} not computed; k=m King deletion of S_{m-1} is asserted via Lemma2.4/Prop3.4 without identifying which isotypic direction is killed; product/convolution proves only existential scalar-module remainder via Bernig-Fu/Wannerer, not explicit tensor constants, and conflates scalar-times-tensor module action with tensor product; Crofton applies scalar densities under the moment map without an area-measure Crofton theorem, so Fubini/weak-continuity does not justify (5.1). Proof vs evidence: only combinatorial determinants are machine-checked; geometric claims are sketches.

originality.rationale: Fused 3-direction search (literal rank-2 U(m) basis; equivalent Hermitian/Minkowski/Crofton-Alesker forms; broader U(m)/O(n)/SL census/database) plus full-text inspection shows nearest prior BDS (arXiv:2003.04649/JFA 2021) gives dimension for all d but explicit basis only for d=1 vector case (Thm 1.2 C(Delta)), not the claimed Q.mu plus (M+-M^J)_0/M^mix rank-2 family with product/Crofton. No table/database lists the 3l+2floor+1 family. Hence headline combination is not recorded or mechanically implied.

value.rationale: If proved, an explicit finite U(m)-equivariant symmetric rank-2 basis attaining the BDS dimension, in second-moment/metric form with Alesker-module and global Crofton description, would close the recognized gap that U(m) tensors are much less understood and BDS left d>=2 without bases. Object (Val_k tensor S^2)^{U(m)} and invariant (explicit basis/dimension) were motivated before computation, value is not known or mechanically implied, and future integral-geometric work could retrieve the precise family. This is a natural classification advance, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
